summary: Feed c084_link_nic is degraded: NPB-01 port 5 sent 14,249,940 packets but NDR eth1 received only 14,048,040 (1.42% loss on the wire) plus 86,160 discards at NDR eth1 (0.61% capture loss), 14x over 0.1% budget. Link error counters are healthy, indicating loss is on the physical path/capture pipeline, not FCS errors.

findings.root_cause: Packets are lost between NPB-01 port 5 and NDR eth1: 1.42% never arrived at the NDR (201,900 packets lost on cable/optic/patch or an unmonitored inline device) and an additional 0.61% (86,160 packets) arrived but were discarded by NDR eth1 because the capture interface/pipeline could not keep up. Link error check is healthy, so not FCS/cabling errors counted by interface.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR misses ~2% of traffic, causing incomplete TCP reassembly, broken flows, missed IDS signatures and reduced detection coverage for lateral movement and exfiltration. Needs both directions and full payload, so any loss directly blinds detection.

recommended_fix.why: Verify/replace optics, cable and patch between NPB-01 port 5 and NDR eth1, check power levels and any unmonitored tap/inline device. After link is clean, address the 0.61% tool discards by tuning NDR capture (RSS/ring buffers, driver) or adding load_balance/tool_capacity if 10G port is oversubscribed.
